metadata.scenario: A customer urgently needs to reschedule a session due to a sudden change in plans. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Agnes Rodriguez. I need to reschedule my companion care session for today, please. Of course, Agnes. I understand it’s urgent. What seems to be the issue? My daughter was supposed to visit today, but she had an emergency and can’t make it. I’m sorry to hear that, Agnes. Let’s find a time that works for you. When would you like to reschedule? Can we move it to tomorrow? I really need some company since my daughter won’t be here. Absolutely, I can check our availability for tomorrow. What time works best for you? Maybe around 10 AM? That would help me a lot. Let me see... Yes, we can schedule a caregiver for you at 10 AM tomorrow! Perfect! Thank you so much, Margaret. I appreciate the quick help. You’re welcome, Agnes! I’ll confirm that appointment for you. Would you like to add any gardening activities to your care plan? Yes, that would be wonderful! I always enjoy those sessions. Great, I’ll make a note for the caregiver to bring some gardening supplies. Thank you! Is there anything else I need to worry about? No, just that I’ll send you a reminder before the appointment. Is your daughter okay? She’s fine, just a little overwhelmed. Thank you for asking. Of course, Agnes. If you need any additional services or support for her, let us know. I will, thank you! Could you also send me a list of available services? Absolutely, I’ll email you our complete list of services and pricing. That would be helpful. Thank you again for your assistance! My pleasure, Agnes! I’ll see you tomorrow at 10 AM. See you then! Goodbye! Goodbye, Agnes! Take care!
